hardware.upstream_search: Mixed CPU + NVIDIA H100 search runs (cluster_fleet_h100_*, joint_itinerary_h100_*); separate G4 SCvx campaign also on H100

model.dynamics: GTOC12 low-thrust continuous dynamics; trajectories certified with the official and independent verifiers
model.local_refine: SCvx (sequential convex) with 40 iterations per settings.scvx_iterations

optimisation.strategy: Multi-stage cluster-fleet + joint-itinerary search over 39 source runs (1,628 chains), then CPU master fleet selection with LP relaxation / branch-and-bound (node_cap 2,000,000), bonus-weighted objective, and route recertification

notes: G4 partial snapshot on disk is a separate low-thrust SCvx GPU campaign, not the fleet_master_v11 assembly clock.
